about.title: The Nordic Zenith
about.subtitle: "Where ancient craftsmanship meets digital excellence."
about.forge.title: Our Digital Forge
about.forge.description: Veridian Zenith is more than a collective—it is a digital forge. We operate in the intersection of ancient aesthetics and cutting-edge performance. Our focus lies in building systems that are as resilient as they are beautiful.
about.philosophy.title: The Philosophy
about.philosophy.description: Every line of code is intentional. Like runes carved into stone, our software is built for permanence, clarity, and uncompromising speed. We believe in the "Nordic Way"—minimalist, effective, and powerful.
about.license.title: The License
about.license.description: We believe in the sanctity of open source. Veridian Zenith artifacts are released under the
about.license.description2: , ensuring the code remains free and accessible to all who seek it.
projects.title: Arcane Artifacts
projects.subtitle: Explore the digital runes we've carved. Artifacts of systems, security, and digital experience.
projects.voix.description: A secure privilege management tool (sudo/doas alternative) featuring PAM authentication and a focus on minimal attack surface.
projects.galdr.description: Minimal initramfs generator for Linux. Replaces mkinitcpio with something fast, safe, and simple.
projects.ljod.description: Veridian Zenith — forged sound, open forge. A music and audio project built for the void.
projects.llamacpp_ui.description: A modern web UI for llama.cpp, built with React and TypeScript. Chat with local AI models in style.
projects.meshiji.description: A modern, Linux-only file explorer built with Flutter. Provides a clean, intuitive interface for managing files.
projects.peguni.description: A text-based virtual pet simulator featuring a unique constructed language (Vaesktöng). A companion in the terminal, built for the void.
projects.dds.description: Dynamic Discord Rich Presence based on active Hyprland and COSMIC windows. Automatically updates your Discord status from the active window, with support for Hyprland (Wayland) and COSMIC desktop.
projects.wuming.description: A simple ClamAV GUI frontend written in C using GTK4/LibAdwaita.
